stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The accountant checked the shop's records.
items.sentenceZh: 会计核对了商店的账目。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese family-run bakery, a professional accountant reviews neat blank ledger sheets and receipts with the owner, comparing a simple pictorial sales chart to a tray of baked goods. No readable figures, text, logo or stock-photo posing.
items.altText: 中国家庭面包店里，会计与店主核对经营账目。

items.sentenceEn: The market was full of colorful kites.
items.sentenceZh: 集市上到处都是色彩缤纷的风筝。
items.scene: At a lively contemporary Chinese kite market, many distinct kites in rich varied colors and shapes hang overhead while visitors admire them; emphasize broad color variety, not one dominant hue. No writing or logos.
items.altText: 中国风筝集市里，各种颜色与形状的风筝挂满摊位。

items.sentenceEn: Small savings accumulate over time.
items.sentenceZh: 小额储蓄会随着时间逐渐积累。
items.scene: A calm three-panel progression of one adult adding a few coins to the same transparent savings jar on several separate days, with jar gradually filling. Focus on ongoing verb/process, no currency symbol, dates or digits.
items.altText: 有人多次往存钱罐里放入少量硬币，储蓄逐渐增加。

items.sentenceEn: The accumulation of leaves blocked the drain.
items.sentenceZh: 堆积的落叶堵住了排水口。
items.scene: After autumn wind, a large finished pile of fallen leaves has collected over a street drain and water pools beside it; a worker prepares to clear it. Focus on the resulting accumulation, not individual leaves falling.
items.altText: 大量落叶已堆积在排水口，造成积水。

items.sentenceEn: The constitution protects fundamental rights.
items.sentenceZh: 宪法保护基本权利。
items.scene: A fictional constitution represented by a dignified blank bound civic document at center; around it, diverse citizens equally access public services, speak at a community meeting and receive fair treatment. No real national flags, emblems, legal text or logos.
items.altText: 一部虚构的宪法文件与平等享有基本权利的公民。

items.sentenceEn: The accused waited for the hearing with her lawyer.
items.sentenceZh: 被指控的女子与律师一起等待听证。
items.scene: In a fictional courthouse waiting area before any hearing, an adult woman sits beside her lawyer reviewing a blank case folder, calm but concerned; court doors remain closed. No cuffs, police custody, implied guilt, real insignia or readable text.
items.altText: 一名被指控的女子与律师在听证前等待，尚未作出裁决。

items.sentenceEn: The trainer showed the runners how to warm up.
items.sentenceZh: 教练向跑者示范如何热身。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese community athletics track, a qualified trainer demonstrates a safe dynamic warm-up stretch to a small group of adult runners, who copy the motion. Trainer clearly leads instruction, no brand marks or writing.
items.altText: 中国社区运动场上，教练带领跑者做热身动作。

items.sentenceEn: The family gathered for Thanksgiving dinner.
items.sentenceZh: 一家人聚在一起吃感恩节晚餐。
items.scene: A diverse American family and friends share a warm autumn Thanksgiving meal around a table with roast turkey and seasonal vegetables, expressing gratitude to each other through gestures. No pilgrim costumes, flags, labels or stereotypes.
items.altText: 一家人与朋友围坐餐桌，共享感恩节晚餐。

items.sentenceEn: They planted an acre of sunflowers.
items.sentenceZh: 他们种植了一英亩向日葵。
items.scene: A single surveyed rectangular farm plot filled with sunflowers is clearly bounded by corner posts and a footpath, with a farmer viewing the whole parcel from a slight aerial angle. Area of land is focus, not one flower; no measurements or numbers.
items.altText: 一块边界清楚的向日葵田，占地一英亩。

items.sentenceEn: Press the button to activate the lamp.
items.sentenceZh: 按下按钮启动这盏灯。
items.scene: Close view of an adult finger pressing a simple button on an unbranded desk lamp; a soft before-and-after transition shows lamp changing from off to warmly lit. Clear activating action, no written labels or symbols.
items.altText: 手指按下按钮，台灯由关闭转为点亮。

items.sentenceEn: The scent of tea leaves filled the room.
items.sentenceZh: 茶叶的清香充满了房间。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese tea workshop, freshly warmed tea leaves in a shallow bowl release subtle fragrant wisps; an adult gently inhales with appreciative expression, tea leaves focal. No perfume bottle or visible smoke.
items.altText: 中国茶作坊里，温热茶叶散发清香，品茶者闻到香味。

items.sentenceEn: The activation of the solar system powered the building.
items.sentenceZh: 太阳能系统的启用为建筑供电。
items.scene: A technician completes a safe startup sequence at a solar inverter; rooftop solar panels connect to a building whose lights turn on in a clear before-and-after visual. Focus on system activation event rather than pressing a generic lamp button, no text or brand.
items.altText: 技术人员启用太阳能系统后，建筑里的灯亮起来。

items.sentenceEn: She made a stack of clean towels.
items.sentenceZh: 她把干净的毛巾叠成一摞。
items.scene: A person neatly places folded clean towels one on top of another on a shelf, forming a stable visible vertical stack. No sacks, computers or words.
items.altText: 她把多条干净毛巾整齐叠成一摞。

items.sentenceEn: The owl's acute hearing caught a faint rustle.
items.sentenceZh: 猫头鹰敏锐的听觉捕捉到轻微的沙沙声。
items.scene: At night in a woodland, an anatomically accurate owl tilts its head toward a tiny mouse rustling under fallen leaves beyond sight; subtle sound-wave curves show detection of a faint noise. No attack, injury or human medical scene.
items.altText: 夜间猫头鹰听见落叶下极轻的沙沙声，体现敏锐听觉。

items.sentenceEn: She raised one eyebrow in surprise.
items.sentenceZh: 她惊讶地挑起一边眉毛。
items.scene: Close three-quarter portrait of an adult woman showing one clearly raised eyebrow and a surprised but natural expression; other facial features complete, eyebrow unmistakable focal feature. No makeup tutorial text.
items.altText: 女子惊讶地挑起一边眉毛，眉部表情清晰可见。

items.sentenceEn: The play was an adaptation of a folk story.
items.sentenceZh: 这出戏改编自一个民间故事。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese theater rehearsal, a storyteller's illustrated folktale scroll is shown alongside a small stage scene with the same distinctive characters and setting transformed into live actors. Clear source-to-stage relationship, no readable writing.
items.altText: 中国剧场里，一则民间故事被改编成舞台剧。

items.sentenceEn: He carried a sack of rice to the storehouse.
items.sentenceZh: 他把一袋大米搬进仓库。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese rice cooperative, an adult worker safely carries one sturdy burlap sack of rice into a clean storehouse; another partly open sack shows rice grains. Focus on sack container, not dismissal from work.
items.altText: 中国稻米合作社里，工人将一只麻袋装的米搬进仓库。

items.sentenceEn: His gaming addiction disrupted his sleep.
items.sentenceZh: 他对游戏的沉迷影响了睡眠。
items.scene: A compassionate split scene of an adult repeatedly gaming late into the night with tired eyes, then struggling to stay alert the next morning; a supportive friend offers conversation. Avoid shame, caricature, substance use, diagnosis claim or readable screens.
items.altText: 成年人长期深夜沉迷游戏，次日疲惫，朋友关心他的状态。

items.sentenceEn: The rain ceased by morning.
items.sentenceZh: 雨到早晨停了。
items.scene: Same quiet village street across a subtle night-to-morning transition: heavy rain and ripples fade, clouds part and morning sunlight falls on wet ground with no new raindrops. Focus on stopping, not starting rain.
items.altText: 村街的雨夜过后，清晨雨已停，地面仍湿。

items.sentenceEn: Additionally, she packed a flashlight.
items.sentenceZh: 此外，她还装了一支手电筒。
items.scene: Traveler has already packed a small bag with basic items, then deliberately adds one extra flashlight into an open side pocket; a faint two-step before-after composition emphasizes addition. No text or labels.
items.altText: 旅行者装好基本物品后，又额外放入一支手电筒。
